def nfeats(r,c,C,Bset):
    f={}
    others=[(q[0]-r,q[1]-c) for q in Bset if q!=(r,c)]
    dirs={'N':(-1,0),'S':(1,0),'E':(0,1),'W':(0,-1),'NE':(-1,1),'NW':(-1,-1),'SE':(1,1),'SW':(1,-1)}
    for dn,(dr,dc) in dirs.items():
        f['ray_'+dn]=sum(1 for (a,b) in others if a==dr*(abs(dr) and abs(a)//abs(dr) if dr else 0) and False) # placeholder
    # ray counts: q = p + k*d
    for dn,(dr,dc) in dirs.items():
        f['ray_'+dn]=sum(1 for q in Bset if q!=(r,c) and any(q==(r+k*dr,c+k*dc) for k in range(1,7)))
    # quadrant counts no-wrap
    f['q_NW']=sum(1 for (a,b) in others if a<0 and b<0)
    f['q_NE']=sum(1 for (a,b) in others if a<0 and b>0)
    f['q_SW']=sum(1 for (a,b) in others if a>0 and b<0)
    f['q_SE']=sum(1 for (a,b) in others if a>0 and b>0)
    f['q_N']=sum(1 for (a,b) in others if a<0 and b==0)
    f['q_S']=sum(1 for (a,b) in others if a>0 and b==0)
    f['q_W']=sum(1 for (a,b) in others if a==0 and b<0)
    f['q_E']=sum(1 for (a,b) in others if a==0 and b>0)
    # torus quadrants: dr mod R in {1,2,3}=S,{4,5,6}=N ; dc mod C: if C even split 1..C/2-1 and C/2+1..; use sign of minimal rep? use: dc mod C <= C//2 -> E else W (0=same col)
    for q_ in range(4): pass
    f['t_NW']=sum(1 for (a,b) in others if (a%7) in (4,5,6) and (b%C)>=(C+1)//2)
    f['t_NE']=sum(1 for (a,b) in others if (a%7) in (4,5,6) and 0<(b%C)<=(C//2))
    f['t_SW']=sum(1 for (a,b) in others if (a%7) in (1,2,3) and (b%C)>=(C+1)//2)
    f['t_SE']=sum(1 for (a,b) in others if (a%7) in (1,2,3) and 0<(b%C)<=(C//2))
    f['left']=1 if c==0 else 0; f['right']=1 if c+1>=C-1 else 0
    f['top']=1 if r==0 else 0; f['bot']=1 if r+1>=6 else 0
    f['nc']=len(Bset); f['C']=C
    f['c']=c; f['r']=r
    return f
